messages:
Olive: Quick PSA: if you lose a bracket and blame the snack table, you might be onto something. I spilled salsa and my bracket got salty. :taco:
Samir: Same, my second-round upset pick auto-failed when I stepped away for pizza. RIP. :pizza:
Jules: Which upset? I thought the committee seeded the snacks better this year.
Rae: GIF: tiny chaos (link)
Olive: I picked the 12 over 5 and then the 12's starter fouled out in the first quarter. timing is a curse.
Samir: Also real talk - waiver snafu tonight. I bid 2 FAAB on a streamer at 11:58 and the system processed at 12:03. anyone else?
pool-bot: "pool-bot: Transaction notice: Samir's bid for D. Ellis processed at 00:03. Current FAAB: Samir 4.2, Olive 9.0, Jules 1.5"
Jules: that's rough. I submitted a bid of 1.5 and got outbid by 0.1. The decimals are theatrical.
Rae: @league-commish can we standardize the FAAB increments? 0.1 is just cruel.
league-commish: noted. I'll propose 0.5 minimum increments and move roster lock to 10:30pm. Will post the poll.
Olive: Bless you. Also side bet: whoever loses bracket owes the office pizza night. I nominate myself as pizza czar if I win.
Samir: Formal challenge accepted. I will draft a pizza menu more complex than our snack table.
Jules: For the record, my lineup before the buzzer was:
```
PG: Young
SG: Hield
SF: Middleton
PF: Grant
C: Lopez
BN: NightStream, DeepBench
```
Samir: Hield finally had a night and my bench rejoiced.
Rae: Poll: who wins the conference semis this weekend? React: 🟢 Top Seed / 🟡 Grit Team / 🔴 Defensive Squad / 🔵 Chaos Pick
Olive: 🔵 Chaos Pick. Always.
Samir: 🟡 Grit Team. defense wins.
Jules: 🟢 Top Seed, if health holds.
league-commish: poll posted in #league-ops. Please vote before tomorrow noon.
Rae: Also, tiny comms: if we do pizza night, can we get dietary tags? last time someone had jalapenos and we lost a teammate for an afternoon.
Olive: noted: vegan/gluten options + allergy tags. I will curate.
Samir: side note: waiver-bot: "waiver-bot: Reminder: FAAB window closes at 11:59pm PT. Processing may take up to 10 minutes."
Jules: End thread: pizza wagers, FAAB grief, and bracket therapy. DM me if you want to negotiate pizza toppings or trade offers. Good luck to bracket survivors.
